name: CARL-D
description: A large-scale vision dataset and benchmark suite for vehicle detection and scene segmentation in driving scenes.
general_score_metric: mAP for detection; mean IoU for segmentation
typical_sota_score: detection mAP ~60–90%; segmentation mean IoU ~50–85% (varies by task and setting)
reputation: A useful large-scale dataset for vehicle detection and scene segmentation in driving research; recognized but less widely adopted than benchmarks like KITTI or Cityscapes.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on driving scenes; potential class imbalance and domain bias versus other driving datasets; not as ubiquitous as KITTI/Cityscapes; results depend on task split and evaluation protocol.
